label: challenging
title: Zero-dollar cap on a free pilot

pages.text:
FREE PILOT AGREEMENT

Between Sunfield AI and Terra Grocers.

Section 2. Pilot. Sunfield provides a free ninety-day pilot at no charge.

Section 5. Liability. Liability is capped at the fees paid for the pilot.

Signed. Signature: Ann Lowe. Signature: Bob Mann.

evidence.quote: Liability is capped at the fees paid for the pilot.

expected.rationale: Fees paid are $0, so the stated cap may offer no real limit — but a cap is literally stated. Flagging for legal review or not flagging are both reasonable; needs_legal_review is the right handling, not a definitive call.
